content.text: When a customer adds a public comment on an escalated ticket, the escalation timer resets to the full SLA window.
Timer reset should apply only to agent-owned clocks, not customer comments that should leave the escalation deadline unchanged.
Adjust timer rules, backfill incorrectly extended escalations still open, and cover the case in SLA unit tests.
